question: Does the frozen 3D Street View center-scale lock retrieve the same stable 3RScan door or doorframe across registered rescans when geometry supplies only a fully visible proposal?

frozen_cohort.selection_order: Use candidate_protocol rows in its frozen descending area_proxy order. Exclude every exact (reference_scan_id, rescan_id, target_instance_id) found in consumed_target_cohorts; require a previously unused reference_scan_id within this cohort; select the first three rows whose reference and rescan both pass frame_rules. Pose, depth and instance geometry may be read during freeze; RGB members must remain unopened until replay.
frozen_cohort.proposal_rule: Project the selected stable instance vertices with evaluator-authoritative pose and intrinsics, take the frozen tight bounding box, crop raw RGB, then square-pad the shorter dimension with black. The 32-pixel frame margin is fixed before RGB from the SceneNN edge-clipping falsifier.
frozen_cohort.retrieval_rule: Each of three reference proposals ranks all three rescan proposals and each rescan proposal ranks all three reference proposals, yielding six directed anchors, six positives and twelve same-class cross-target negatives.
forbidden: lowering the 32-pixel visibility margin after selection
treating a truth proposal as a detector

frozen_model.embedding: L2-normalized final CLS token on centered scales 1.0, 0.5 and 0.25.
frozen_model.upgraded_score: 0.25 * global/global cosine + 0.75 * maximum cosine where at least one side is a centered crop.
forbidden: reranking with scan or target identity

decision_gate.minimum_positive_margin: strictly greater than zero for every anchor
decision_gate.single_replay: One frozen replay. Do not tune on the selected RGB proposals.

claim_boundary: A pass is a small real-image Development canary that the frozen same-point appearance lock transfers from outdoor 3D Street View to truth-proposed stable indoor 3RScan door or doorframe instances. 3RScan mesh, pose, depth, RGB and semantic labels come from one provider; target triples are disjoint from the four enumerated prior cohorts but scan families may have appeared in prior Development; proposals use privileged reconstructed geometry; and only three physical targets are tested. It is not door detection, pixel-mask transfer, doorway aperture, named entrance, venue ownership, public access, traversability, approach waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, open-world or provider-independent confirmation, user benefit or mobility-safety evidence.
